verdict.rationale: Ollama runs local models alongside its own hosted cloud models through the same API, CLI and launch command. The evidence covers local and cloud base URLs, running larger models on Ollama's Cloud without a download, and `ollama launch` working with local or cloud models. However, the only cloud provider shown is Ollama's own: nothing shows it connecting to third-party providers such as OpenAI or Anthropic. Its OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility runs the other way, letting outside clients call Ollama. Missing for 10: connecting to third-party cloud AI providers, a documented unified interface mixing provider backends, and independent hands-on corroboration of the local and cloud workflow.
